concerns.text: The orchestrator task T113 is placed before task T116 (covariate‑adjusted LRT). Since T116 consumes the selected knot produced by T109 and the model outputs from T111, it must run after those producer tasks. The orchestrator, which is supposed to run all stages in the correct order, should be the final task in Phase 1 (or at least after all analysis tasks), otherwise the pipeline may attempt to execute T116 without the required inputs.
